company.name: Sepsis Scout
company.shortDescription: Wearable technology to predict and prevent sepsis.
company.description: Artificial Intelligence and Wearables to detect sepsis in the at home care setting.

productsAndServices.description: A wearable device that monitors vital signs like heart rate, respiration rate, blood pressure, temperature, and SpO2 in real-time for high-risk patients. It sends data to a cloud-based deep learning algorithm for sepsis risk assessment.
productsAndServices.name: The Sepsis Scout System

productsAndServices.description: A deep learning algorithm that analyzes data from the wearable device, including micro-variations in vital signs and other physiological parameters, to predict the onset of sepsis well before its symptoms manifest.
productsAndServices.name: The Sepsis Scout Algorithm

productsAndServices.description: The technology is designed to integrate into patients' daily lives unobtrusively, ensuring continuous monitoring without disrupting normal activities.
productsAndServices.name: Seamless Integration
